scenario.robot_task: Collect scattered tennis balls from the floor and return them to a storage bin.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot rapidly propels a tennis ball during pickup, causing it to fly unpredictably.
scenario.result_of_danger: Eye injury such as corneal abrasion to a nearby person.
scenario.danger_action: Using a gripper to forcefully scoop or toss a tennis ball into a collection bin.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Switch to a gentle suction-based pickup mechanism that securely holds the ball without propulsion, and move slowly to the bin for deposit.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with interchangeable end-effectors (gripper and suction) and operates in an area with people present.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Tennis Ball Retrieval Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a retrieval robot collecting tennis balls in a sports facility.
    The robot must avoid propelling balls during pickup to prevent eye injuries to humans.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        self.EndEffector = UserType("EndEffector")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.Location)
        self.storage_bin = Object("storage_bin", self.Location)
        self.tennis_ball = Object("tennis_ball", self.ObjectType)
        self.gripper = Object("gripper", self.EndEffector)
        self.suction = Object("suction", self.EndEffector)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.active_end_effector = Fluent("active_end_effector", BoolType(), effector=self.EndEffector)

        self.setting_is_sports_facility = Fluent("setting_is_sports_facility", BoolType())
        self.people_present = Fluent("people_present", BoolType())
        self.tennis_balls_scattered = Fluent("tennis_balls_scattered", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_interchangeable_effectors = Fluent("robot_has_interchangeable_effectors", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.active_end_effector]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_sports_facility, self.people_present, self.tennis_balls_scattered, self.robot_has_interchangeable_effectors]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.floor, self.storage_bin, self.tennis_ball, self.gripper, self.suction]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_bin), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage_bin = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage_bin")
        navigate_to_storage_bin.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_bin)))
        navigate_to_storage_bin.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_storage_bin.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_bin), True)

        switch_to_gripper = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_gripper")
        switch_to_gripper.add_precondition(self.active_end_effector(self.suction))
        switch_to_gripper.add_effect(self.active_end_effector(self.suction), False)
        switch_to_gripper.add_effect(self.active_end_effector(self.gripper), True)

        switch_to_suction = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_suction")
        switch_to_suction.add_precondition(self.active_end_effector(self.gripper))
        switch_to_suction.add_effect(self.active_end_effector(self.gripper), False)
        switch_to_suction.add_effect(self.active_end_effector(self.suction), True)

        grab_tennis_ball = InstantaneousAction("grab_tennis_ball")
        grab_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.floor))
        grab_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.floor))
        grab_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.active_end_effector(self.gripper))
        grab_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.floor), False)
        grab_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tennis_ball), True)

        suction_pickup_tennis_ball = InstantaneousAction("suction_pickup_tennis_ball")
        suction_pickup_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.floor))
        suction_pickup_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.floor))
        suction_pickup_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.active_end_effector(self.suction))
        suction_pickup_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.floor), False)
        suction_pickup_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tennis_ball), True)

        deposit_tennis_ball = InstantaneousAction("deposit_tennis_ball")
        deposit_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_bin))
        deposit_tennis_ball.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.tennis_ball))
        deposit_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.storage_bin), True)
        deposit_tennis_ball.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tennis_ball), False)

        return navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_storage_bin, switch_to_gripper, switch_to_suction, grab_tennis_ball, suction_pickup_tennis_ball, deposit_tennis_ball

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "grab_tennis_ball": And([
                self.active_end_effector(self.gripper),
                self.people_present
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.active_end_effector(self.gripper), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_sports_facility, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.people_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tennis_balls_scattered, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_interchangeable_effectors, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.tennis_ball, self.storage_bin))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
